mapper.sql: m.menu_seq, m.menu_id, m.menu_name, m.parent_seq, m.route_name, m.icon, m.perm_seq, m.sort_order, m.use_yn, m.created_by, m.created_at, m.updated_by, m.updated_at, g.menu_id AS parent_id, g.menu_name AS parent_name, p.perm_id, p.perm_name
FROM tb_menu m LEFT JOIN tb_menu g ON g.menu_seq = m.parent_seq LEFT JOIN tb_permission p ON p.perm_seq = m.perm_seq
ORDER BY COALESCE(g.sort_order, m.sort_order), COALESCE(g.menu_seq, m.menu_seq), m.parent_seq NULLS FIRST, m.sort_order, m.menu_id
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_menu WHERE menu_id = #{menuId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_menu WHERE parent_seq = #{menuSeq}

WITH granted AS ( SELECT DISTINCT rp.perm_seq FROM tb_user_role ur JOIN tb_role r ON r.role_seq = ur.role_seq AND r.use_yn = 'Y' JOIN tb_role_permission rp ON rp.role_seq = r.role_seq WHERE ur.user_seq = #{userSeq} AND rp.action_code = 'R' ), visible_item AS ( SELECT m.* FROM tb_menu m WHERE m.use_yn = 'Y' AND m.parent_seq IS NOT NULL AND ( m.perm_seq IS NULL OR m.perm_seq IN (SELECT perm_seq FROM granted) ) ) SELECT
WHERE m.use_yn = 'Y' AND ( m.menu_seq IN (SELECT menu_seq FROM visible_item) OR m.menu_seq IN (SELECT parent_seq FROM visible_item) )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_menu SET menu_name = #{menuName}, parent_seq = #{parentSeq}, route_name = #{routeName}, icon = #{icon}, perm_seq = #{permSeq}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, use_yn = #{useYn}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE menu_seq = #{menuSeq}
